title: R’ Avdimum
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was one of the five sons of Rabbi Yose ben Chalafta, and he is mentioned by this name in Yevamot ch. 1, halakhah 1; and see the entry Vordimus.[^1]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:1, paragraph 6, lists five sons, including Rabbi Evdimos, and fully names Rabbi Yose ben Chalafta. Hyman’s heading Avdimum and cross-reference Vordimus are retained as supplied. The fully written title beside Evdimos does not establish the title of every spelling or an identity between the entries.
